sections.words: ​ ​ I’m Courtney Acamo, an intuitive healer, embodiment guide, ceremonialist, and sound priestess, fueled with a passion for the healing arts and women’s empowerment. For the last seven years, I have been cultivating a private healing practice that guides and empowers courageous souls through their unique evolutionary journey of healing, purification, and awakening. Whether through ceremonies, retreats, individual mentorships, or healing sessions. I create powerful transformational containers for those ready to awaken their creativity, heal from past traumas, reconnect with their innocence and joy, and remember their union with love and all of life. I'm here as an ally in your liberation, leadership, and the embodiment of all that you are. ​ In Love and Devotion, ​ Courtney Hi, it’s nice to meet you.

sections.words: About me My path into healing arts began at a very young age, developing my psychic abilities, compassion, and sensitivities through intense hardship. By the time I was in my late teens, I manifested several physical accidents that resulted in multiple surgeries and severe spinal issues causing unbearable pain. This was the very catalyst to launch me passionately onto my path of seeking modalities that would liberate me from my physical and emotional suffering. I've now traveled the world studying a variety of powerful transformational tools and healing modalities in diverse ranges of teachings and ancient wisdom traditions. Ranging from yoga of the voice, ancestral healing, NLP, Internal family systems, energy healing, chi gong, tao tantra, improv, meditation, plant medicine, yin yoga, sound healing, and women's circle facilitation. My passion is in helping others turn their pain into power, access their creative potential, and live a life they love.
